Flight Phase

Снижение тяги

A standard procedure to reduce engine thrust from take-off power to a lower, climb-appropriate setting at a specific altitude or waypoint after take-off.

Questions and answers

What is Снижение тяги?

In this glossary, Снижение тяги refers to: A standard procedure to reduce engine thrust from take-off power to a lower, climb-appropriate setting at a specific altitude or waypoint after take-off.

How is Снижение тяги used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "На высоте снижения тяги уменьшите мощность двигателя со взлетного на наборную и подтвердите завершение процедуры."

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A standard procedure to reduce engine thrust from take-off power to a lower, climb-appropriate setting at a specific altitude or waypoint after take-off.

Operational example

At thrust reduction altitude, reduce engine power from take-off to climb setting and confirm thrust reduction complete.

Localized term

Снижение тяги

Localized example

На высоте снижения тяги уменьшите мощность двигателя со взлетного на наборную и подтвердите завершение процедуры.
